name: atel-text
description: Shows the message text behind Text[n], and the game's names behind Target, Command, Map and Battle values, in decompiled Atel# (FFX) C# sources, from your own game's tables.

atel.textLanguage.description: The language whose message text is shown for Text[n] (a folder of .atel/text, written by `atel text export`), and whose names are shown for Target, Command, Map and Battle values (.atel/names, `atel names export`).

atel.textDirectory.description: The folder with one subfolder per language (`en/bjyt0400.json`, …). Empty: the nearest `.atel/text` above the file.

atel.namesDirectory.description: The folder of `atel names export` with one subfolder per language (`en/monsters.json`, …). Empty: the nearest `.atel/names` above the file.

atel.inlayHints.names.description: Show the game's name after Target, Command, Map and Battle values (`Target.Biran`, `(Command)0x3000`) as an inlay hint.

atel.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show the message text after Text[n] (and, with atel.inlayHints.names, the game's names) as inlay hints.

atel.inlayHints.maxLength.description: Inlay hints longer than this are cut with an ellipsis (at a word where it can); the hover shows the whole message.

scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --out atel-text.vsix
